circulation.method: Real keyboard W, mouse look and E interactions. Only initial fixture camera placement; all room/stair travel uses real controls and existing navigation.
unreachable: The original static garage has no exported internal doorway or navigation. It was visually captured, not walked.

geometryAudit.method: Read-only glTF JSON/accessor world bounds comparison with float64 node transforms; no Blender import, no browser or test rerun. Architecture selection by original structural/window/stair/garage names.

geometry.blenderVsGltfNote: glTF vertex accessors split vertices for UVs/normals/material boundaries. Use actual runtime counters for performance.

geometryAudit.verificationLimit: Static/code audit only; runtime circulation, actual rendering and timing belong to separate QA report.
